rows.note: Use 合集 for a compiled collection of articles or online posts, especially when it is not a named digest magazine.

example.english: This digest compiles the good articles we read online this week.
example.traditional: 呢個合集整理咗我哋今個星期喺網上睇過嘅好文章。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hap6 zaap6 zing2 lei5 zo2 ngo5 dei6 gam1 go3 sing1 kei4 hai2 mong5 soeng6 tai2 gwo3 ge3 hou2 man4 zoeng1

rows.note: Use 文摘 for a digest-style publication or selected-article magazine such as Reader's Digest.

example.english: This digest selects several of the most worthwhile articles to read.
example.traditional: 呢本文摘揀咗幾篇最值得睇嘅文章。
example.jyutping: ni1 bun2 man4 zaak6 gaan2 zo2 gei2 pin1 zeoi3 zik6 dak1 tai2 ge3 man4 zoeng1
